summary: Official Punjab PULSE and Punjab Land Records Authority routes establish a first-party cadastral/land-record custodian and explicitly name Toba Tek Singh in the viewer configuration. The public viewer page was inspected, but Toba hierarchy/parcel API calls returned bearer-token authorization failures and the referenced Toba-specific ArcGIS host did not resolve. No Toba parcel geometry was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Urdu discovery queries are recorded in the city record. They identified official Punjab PULSE, PLRA, and Toba Tek Singh district sources.
requestOutcomes: The PULSE viewer returned HTTP 200 and its current JavaScript was inspected. District/mauza/statistics routes returned HTTP 401 without a bearer token. An anonymous parcel endpoint returned unrelated mauza data and was excluded. The Toba-specific referenced ArcGIS host and active gismaps host failed DNS resolution. No login, credentials, private tokens, unsafe fields, TLS disablement, or contact was used.
